reaction: The slipping-glass sequence makes the purpose of contact feedback clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was most worthwhile because it brought skin sensation, nerves and muscle action together in a familiar task.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two skin layers felt predictable after making them, although the resulting cross-section helped show where the vessels sit.

surprise.text: The skin cross-section showed that supplies reach living surface cells from vessels in the supporting layer, without blood cells entering the surface layer.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter connected the assembled systems to another everyday action. The glass sequence was more engaging than the predictable assembly steps.
